title: Create project documentation standard
notes: Added README.md, docs/documentation-standard.md, docs/logic.md, docs/pwa-standard.md, task.md, and task.jsonl.

title: Create first HTML XOR cipher demo
notes: Built index.html with key input, plaintext/ciphertext textareas, encrypt/decrypt actions, copy buttons, clear button, grouping toggle, security notice, and XOR byte table.

title: Add numeric ciphertext validation
notes: Implemented digits-only validation, whitespace cleanup, length divisible by 3 check, and 000-255 byte range validation in js/app.js.

title: Add optional PWA support
notes: Added manifest.json, sw.js, offline.html, favicon.svg, generated PNG icons, install prompt handling, and update banner flow.

title: Add GitHub Pages deployment workflow
notes: Added .github/workflows/deploy.yml using official GitHub Pages Actions for static site deployment.

title: Fix GitHub Pages first-run deployment failure
notes: Investigated GitHub Actions failure: configure-pages returned Pages site Not Found because Pages was not enabled or not configured for GitHub Actions. Added configure-pages enablement:true and FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24:true to address first-run enablement and Node 20 deprecation warning.

title: Review and fix UI/PWA edge issues
notes: Fixed hidden elements being shown by component display rules, improved Service Worker offline fallback order and response caching guard, and added clipboard fallback for non-secure contexts.

title: Extract reusable XOR number cipher library
notes: Added js/xor-number-cipher.js as a DOM-free single-file browser library exposing XORNumberCipher and XORCipherTool APIs. Refactored js/app.js to call the library and updated README/docs/task files.

title: Document library usage for engineers and AI agents
notes: Added docs/library.md, documented browser and Node/CommonJS usage, added CommonJS export support to js/xor-number-cipher.js, and bumped the Service Worker version after adding a new precached library file.

title: Show before and after textarea length counters
notes: Added live counters beside plaintext and ciphertext labels. Plaintext shows Unicode character count and UTF-8 byte count; ciphertext shows cleaned digit count and complete 3-digit group count.

title: Add optional zip APIs for long numeric ciphertext
notes: Added async gzip-based APIs to js/xor-number-cipher.js: zipNumberCiphertext, unzipNumberCiphertext, encryptToZippedNumbers, decryptFromZippedNumbers. Zipped payloads remain number-only by encoding compressed bytes as 3-digit groups.

title: Fix PWA force reload update flow
notes: Bumped Service Worker VERSION to 2026-05-12-3, registered sw.js with updateViaCache:none, immediately called registration.update(), and handled registration.waiting so an already waiting worker shows the reload banner.

title: Expose zipped numeric ciphertext in the UI
notes: Added a Zip encrypted output checkbox. When enabled, Encrypt uses encryptToZippedNumbers and Decrypt uses decryptFromZippedNumbers; button labels and status text update to make the active format visible. Bumped Service Worker VERSION to 2026-05-12-4 so the UI change updates in PWA installs.

title: Skip zip output when gzip makes ciphertext longer
notes: Added encryptToShortestNumbers to compare normal and zipped numeric ciphertext. UI zip mode now outputs zipped numbers only when shorter; otherwise it keeps normal ciphertext and displays a skip message with both lengths. Bumped Service Worker VERSION to 2026-05-12-5.
